records.text: Owens questioned the timing of Tyler Robinson’s reported encounter with a social-media woman, given his departure before 928 and the staff arrival entries; she allowed that the women might have arrived earlier.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: My issue immediately, what I'm thinking about when I look at that is we are told that Tyler Robinson is going to go up to a girl. I know it's a girl. I know who the girl is and she's involved in social media. ... And he's going to leave. He leaves campus by what actually like nine, nine thirty three. He pulls out of campus nine twenty four. ... So unless this girl arrived with security. At 904, I am very interested in determining when the group of girls arrived, because that is very interesting. If Tyler Robinson has to go up to anybody before 928, it's likely just security. ... They may have missed this. Now, maybe they did come a little earlier for some reason, but I just wanted to point that out that it makes that interesting, that entry interesting in the Tyler Robinson timeline.
